City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  July 29, 2019

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the July 22, 2019, meeting.

  2. ER Landscape and Maintenance – Executive session to discuss recommended payment
  for landscaping at the new Well site.

  3. ALTA Environmental- Executive session to discuss recommended payment for testing of
  interior and exterior air quality at Rogers Parks’s facility.

  4. Pro Force Law Enforcement – Executive session to discuss payment for headsets for
  Motor Unity’s helmets for Police Department.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.
